items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: He has performed with Cab Calloway, Archie Shepp, and Branford Marsalis

ctx.x: Longineu Parsons is a versatile trumpet player, comfortable in big bands, jazz combos, and classical ensembles. He has performed with Cab Calloway, Archie Shepp, and Branford Marsalis, and is passionate about preserving the legacy of Louis Armstrong.
Longineu was interviewed via Zoom on February 17, 2026 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
